messages.content: Dad already bought a box of old wrenches for five dollars. It's not even eight.
of course he did 😂 is he wearing the vest
The vest and the hat. He's telling the wrench man about his knee.
your mom says don't bring anything sunday, so i'm making the potato salad
my mom already made her lemon bars for your mom. she's so nervous 😂
Dutch Bros run. Your usual or something new?
golden eagle, iced please ❤️
and nothing for mateo, he'll be bouncing off the walls at your mom's
He's asleep. He's making you eggs in twenty minutes, he just doesn't know it yet.
thank you for today. lucía's card made me cry at your mom's table
She worked on it all week. Mateo signed it in the car.
i noticed. his name is sideways 😂
Love you. Happy Mother's Day.
Somebody on Marketplace has four patio cushions about the size of ours. I asked last night if they're still around.
yes please. the old ones have that green spot. how much
Under 40 for all four.
do it
Got the cushions. Clean, no smell, and they fit the chairs.
yay. the old ones go in the trash today. no keeping them just in case
Just in case is a real thing.
not for these 😂
is lucía's white shirt on her bed? she changes at school
On her bed. Ironed. Don't ask who ironed it.
she says Daddy you clapped the loudest ⭐
Tell her I was clapping for the girl in the second row.
she says THAT WAS ME
I know.
At Costco for the AC filter. Need anything else?
New filter is in. The old one was solid gray.
ew. thank you. we're at target, lucía wants slime
No more slime. The last one is still in the couch.
Off. Pizza tonight? Neither of us is cooking.
yes please. little caesars, and i'll do a salad so we feel better about it 😂
Dad wants to know if we need a second grill.
we do not need a second grill. tell him i said that
He says you're no fun.
i'm so much fun. no grill 😂
dropped mateo at camp. he's the only kid without a hat, so that's going great
There's a hat under the passenger seat.
found it. he put it on like i asked him to wear a tie 🙄
Mateo is asleep on the couch with his cleats on. Camp is working.
take the cleats off at least
Done. He didn't move.
All done at Banfield. Shots are in. He was very brave until the scale.
poor baby. what did the scale say
That he could lose a couple of pounds. The vet looked right at me.
because YOU give him tortillas
I'm aware. It came to about 92 with everything.
Marcus needs me on the desk tomorrow, 7 to noon. I said yes.
ok. overtime means i pick the restaurant next time 😂
The rolling toolbox I showed you is still for sale. He wants 135. I'm going to offer 95 tonight.
if he takes it every tool better go in it and off the dryer
Every single one. The garage will be beautiful.
Got the toolbox. It barely fit in the trunk.
mateo is still asleep if you need muscle
happy father's day ❤️ stay in the garage until we call you
I'm organizing sockets. Take your time.
lucía is helping with the pancakes so it could be a while
I have a lot of sockets.
did you see the srp bill 😳
I saw it. July will be worse.
we're doing 80 at night
78. I can't sleep at 80.
79 and you get a fan
62 calls before lunch. Tony has been in an attic in Tolleson since 7.
poor tony. it's 115 out there
at chipotle with the kids. want anything?
I'm good. Checked the washer hoses while you were out. No cracks, nothing wet.
look at you ❤️
At Vallarta. Burger patties are on sale. Two packs or three?
three. rudy and gil can eat a pack between them
javi says they're leaving your mom's around 5. they want los betos when they get here
I'm at Frank's getting his folding tables. I'll call it in.
At QuikTrip for ice. How many bags?
4. and limes
QuikTrip does not believe in limes.
then target, we need plates anyway
biscuit is in the bathtub shaking. the neighbors started
Turn the fan on in there. It covers some of the noise.
lucía is on the floor with him. she says he's scared and she's not
Tell her she's in charge of Biscuit until it stops.
gil wants to know if he can sleep on the couch 😂
Gil can have the couch. Tell him the boys are on the air mattress, so watch his step.
leaving work early to take mateo to ortho at 2:30. lucía's coming with us
done. they tightened everything and he's being very dramatic
He already told me. Several times.
i'm getting him a smoothie and lucía is mad she doesn't get one
There's a bike on Marketplace that would fit Lucía, the next size up from hers. I asked if it's still for sale.
yesss her knees hit the handlebars on the old one. how much
He's asking 130. I'm going to offer 90.
your call, it's under my limit 😂
but don't tell her until it's in the garage
Bike guy took 90. Pickup is next Saturday at 9:30 at the police station.
yay!! i want to see her face
He's not here yet. I'll give him until 10.
Coming home. No bike.
ugh. sorry babe. good thing we didn't tell her
come home, i made chilaquiles ❤️
any word from the bike guy
Messaged him again at lunch. Nothing.
ok
where did you go
Out front with Frank. A big branch came off his mesquite and it's across the sidewalk on 47th Ave.
is it on the car??
No. Nowhere near the car or the lines.
come inside it's still lightning
Two minutes. We're dragging it to the curb.
ray.
Coming in.
the school supply list came out. lucía needs 48 glue sticks. FORTY EIGHT
Is she building a house?
school sent the first day email. monday!! where did the summer go
Into the SRP bill.
Marcus asked me to cover the desk tomorrow morning. 7 to noon.
ok. sunday is backpacks, no excuses
Gloria says our patio chairs are getting chalky.
gloria can see our chairs??
From her side of the block, apparently. She has a handyman for us too.
we're not paying a handyman for plastic chairs 😂 they're fine
both dropped off. lucía walked in without looking back
mateo pretended he didn't know me
That means it went perfect.
i took 40 pictures on the porch and he's blinking in all of them 😂
Mateo is home. He says it was fine and he's starving.
fine is a five star review from him. taquitos in the freezer
Done at Granada. Met all his teachers. The science teacher already knows his name.
uh oh. good or bad
Gil is here. Back before Costco.
Leaving the lake. I caught a sunburn and not much else.
😂 did you put sunscreen on
On my arms.
what are we getting your mom for tomorrow 😬
I thought you had something.
i thought YOU had something
Mom says she wants nothing, which means a plant.
fry's has the purple orchids she likes
Get two. One from us and one from the kids.
strikers schedule came. there goes every saturday until november
and you're grabbing diego tonight too right
I have Tuesdays.
pulling in, tell mateo to be at the door
He's at the door. Cleats on, for once.
Dad found a Maytag washer for 60 dollars. He wants to know if ours still works.
ours works fine, tell him no 😂
He says for now.
don't let him jinx it
picture day and lucía did her own hair. it's a choice
Don't say anything. She'll love it in twenty years.
not a word ❤️ and mateo swears the hoodie comes off for the picture
Off. Last Saturday desk for a while, hopefully.
come home, mateo wants to show you something on the game. his rank or something
State Farm sent the renewal. Going up a little over 7 dollars a month in October.
ugh why. we didn't do anything
No idea. I'll ask Lorena tonight.
The washer is making a grinding noise. Loud, once it gets to spin.
like grinding or the thumping when the towels bunch up
Grinding. Not the towels. I stopped it and took a picture of the plate in case we need the model.
it's not even 3 years old 🙄
Two and a half. I'll look up the warranty tonight.
don't buy anything tonight. we look at it together
Nothing tonight. Just reading.
did the towels at least get clean
Clean and soaking wet. They're drying on the patio chairs.
the chairs are finally useful 😂
tonight is curriculum night. i'll drop you at granada on my way to practice
Ok. Anything you want me to ask?
ask ms nguyen about the reading log. he says he does it and i have never once seen it 🙄
Done. Ms. Nguyen says the reading log is real. Every night, and she collects it on Mondays.
I KNEW IT
we'll get you at 6, wait out front
Out front. She's emailing the slides tomorrow. She talks fast.
Whirlpool wrote back again. They think it's something caught in the tub, a worn pulley, or a bearing. 129 just to come look.
There's a used one on Marketplace for 180 in Tempe, but the plate in her picture doesn't match the model in the ad. Not sold on it.
180 for somebody else's washer?
let's see if ours can be fixed first
leaving now with lucía. field 2 right?
Field 2. We're behind the bench, under the only tree.
we're here. which tree
Turn around.
the washer did the noise again. i stood there and stared at it like it owed me money
Try the delicate cycle. It doesn't spin as hard.
I read the troubleshooting page in the guide last week.
Tolleson field 1 is a dust bowl. Don't come, it's far and there's no shade.
The kids and I have an errand. Do not follow us.
😂 ok ok
Happy birthday. Coffee is made. Stay in bed as long as you want.
thank you ❤️ is that bacon
At Costco. Carla says they'll be at the house at 1. Need anything?
it's my birthday, i need nothing. ok maybe the big croissants
best birthday. thank you for doing all of it
You deserve a lot more than carne asada.
the carne asada was perfect. and the earrings 😭 lucía told me she picked them like six times today
She was very proud. Mateo put in six dollars, for the record.
Ordered a little heater for my desk. The vent over dispatch blows cold on me all day.
😂 good. you've been complaining since june
Since May. Tony laughed for ten minutes.
My heater came. The box looks like somebody stood on it.
does it work
Plugged it in. It works. I'm telling Amazon about the box anyway.
of course you are ❤️
lucía's headphones came. they're huge on her 😂 they slide off when she looks down
Then they go back. Keep them in the box, I'll start a return. We're heading to Target for Mateo's shoes now.
get a size up, his toes are at the end of everything he owns
Returned the shoes. They didn't have his size in the store.
the pinchy ones?
The pinchy ones. The refund goes back to the Visa.
the brakes are squealing so bad. the whole pickup line turned around
I'll call Valley Tire tomorrow.
it honks like a goose
Valley Tire can take the car Monday at 7:45. Brakes and a tire rotation. Can you drop it after the kids?
yes but how do i get to work 😂
They have a shuttle. I asked.
ok, look at you planning
walking over with lucía now
We're on the far side of field 3, by the light pole.
car's at valley tire. the shuttle is taking me to work
there's a man in the waiting room eating a whole burrito at 7:45 and i respect him
Thank you. They'll text me when it's done.
Car is ready. Tony is dropping me there after work.
yay. can you get me at 4:30? then we get lucía together
4:30, out front.
Got it. No more goose.
Out front.
2 min, finishing a chart
saw the trunk or treat flyer. lucía wants to be a bee again
She can be a bee every year until she's thirty.
The resin chair finally gave out. I sat down and the seat split right across.
omg are you ok 😂
I'm fine. The chair is not. The front leg cracked too.
that's the one you always sit in
the sun cooked them this summer. gloria was right
Please don't tell her that.
we need new ones anyway, those are older than mateo
I'll look on Marketplace tomorrow and send you what I find.
i know ❤️ home by 6:30
This one is close to ours. Four chairs, and he wants 80 each.
80 a chair?? that's 320 for plastic
I offered 56. He says that's low and came back at 75.
it is a little low 😂
It's supposed to be. If he comes down to 60, that's 240 for the four. Over your line, so it's your call.
it's an us call. let me look tomorrow when i'm not doing lucía's hair
and find more than one, don't fall in love with the first set
Found another set. Cheaper. I'll show you tonight.
This is the other one. 50 a chair, and she says excellent condition.
ok that's better. still 200 for the four though
so same as the other one, we look at both together before anybody gets a yes
Same deal. Nobody gets a yes yet.
saturday after the game?
Saturday after the game.
did the shoe money come back?
Not yet. It showed up as pending last week, then it dropped off today.
dropped off?? so they took it back?
It never landed. I'm emailing Target tonight.
ugh. i want to get him the right size before his birthday
We will.
any news from target
They're reviewing it. Still nothing on the card.
Walking home for Biscuit. She's the best bee there.
biscuit barked at a four year old dinosaur 🙄
Was it a scary dinosaur?
it was a very small dinosaur
Heading back. Her bucket is full and one wing is broken.
noooo the wings 😭
Looked at flights for spring break, just to see. Southwest nonstop is about 880 for the four of us, there and back.
that's not bad!!
wait they're charging mateo the adult price?
Anybody over 12 pays the adult price. Still a kid to me.
what days
Monday the 15th, back Friday the 19th. Their whole break.
ok that stays off the tablet and off the family calendar
if lucía sees the words san diego, mateo knows in five minutes
Only on my phone. I'm not booking anything until we sit down.
good, because that one is a big ask-me-first 😂
i want to tell them at christmas
Then it stays between us until Christmas.
ok this is the deck. the daisies one he keeps watching videos about
it's 85 on their site. $80 max, somebody has to have it cheaper
and don't show mateo. he's always grabbing your phone when his dies
Saw it. That's the one he had paused on the TV last week.
I'll look tonight. Nobody touches my phone.
lucía asked why we keep whispering 😂
Tell her we're planning Thanksgiving.
mateo's birthday is next thursday and we have bought NOTHING 😬
I know. I'm looking at the one you sent tonight.
and you're doing the cake this time, i did lucía's
I'll order it next week. Chocolate?
he always wants chocolate
Started the return on my heater. They fixed the vent at work, so I don't need it now.
good, it's been sitting on my counter since friday 😂
It goes back by Thursday. I'll drop it at the UPS on 51st.
Printed the headphones label too. Both go out this week.
ok
mother's day lunch at grandma's sunday at 12:30. everyone in real clothes
what are real clothes
not the shorts with the hole
He has a lot of shorts with holes.
theyre comfortable
lucía's concert is at 5! i'll get you both at 4:40, be on the porch
do i have to
yes
On the porch at 4:40. Both of us.
fine
grandma and grandpa get here at 1. mateo, your room
its clean
i can see it from the hallway mateo
Twenty minutes. Then you're free.
Pizza tonight. Last call for orders.
pepperoni
lucía says cheese, and she says please
Two pizzas and crazy bread.
bet
camp all week! cleats, water, hat. we leave at 6:50
k
lunch at grandma and grandpa's at 12:30. grandpa is grilling, so nobody touch the grill
I will sit in the shade and touch nothing.
can i touch the grill
no
117 today. nobody takes biscuit on the sidewalk this afternoon, it burns his feet
he doesnt want to go anyway hes under the table
tío javi, marisa and nico get here tomorrow afternoon
mateo they're in your room. you and nico are on the air mattress
why my room
because you have the big bed
ok but nico cant touch my switch
Nico is eight. He will touch your Switch.
jobs today: mateo chairs and ice chests, dad grill, lucía napkins and she's taking it very seriously
why do i get the heavy stuff
Because you're the strongest one here after Grandpa.
fr
is the power out or just my room
the whole street
Whole block. Flashlights are in the hall closet.
my phone is at 9%
Then stop texting and save it.
ok
WIFI IS BACK
go to sleep 😂
first day tomorrow!! clothes out tonight, we leave at 7:10
I'll be gone by then, so good luck now. Both of you.
ty
lucía says mr. hart has a lizard in the classroom
we had a lizard in 4th grade too
his name is gus 😂
Gus sounds like a good student.
hes a lizard
grandma's birthday lunch tomorrow at 12:30. card is on the counter, everybody sign it
i signed it
you signed lucía's drawing
same thing
Sign the card, mijo.
ok ok
picture day!! mateo NO hoodie
its cold
it's 88 degrees
Hoodie off for the picture. Then wear it all day if you want.
leaving for gil's at 11:40. shoes on
diego is coming right
Gil said yes. We're picking him up on the way.
first game today!! lucía made a sign
pls dont bring the sign
too late
Leaving at 8:15. The sign is coming.
happy birthday mom
thank you baby ❤️ why are you awake
dad
grandma's all week for fall break. bags by the door at 7:15 tomorrow
every day?
every day. she's making fideo
ok fine
saturday's game moved to field 3, not field 2. something about the sprinklers
ik coach said
trunk or treat at 5! mateo you're coming for 20 minutes
im 13
and you like candy
ok
I'm there until 5:50, then Biscuit.
halloween rules. mateo home by 9, phone charged, stay with diego
ik
Lucía and I leave at 7:15. Bee wings are on.
costco at 10, anybody need anything
chicken bake
One chicken bake. Noted.
ty
for my bday can we do birria
ask your dad, he's the cook
Grandma is coming at 4 to make your enchiladas. Birria another time.
pls
did grandpa get me anyting
A wrench.
fr
No. Churros. They're on the counter.
bet
Up. You're making Mom eggs.
its sunday
It's Mother's Day. Eggs.
omw
where r u
By the gym doors. Where are you?
saying bye to my old pe teacher
Take your time. Mom is in the cookie line.
omw out
SCHOOL IS OVER
Congratulations, eighth grader.
can i go to diegos
Ask Mom, she's home.
she said ask u
Then yes. Home by 6.
its so hot
Water. Hat.
coach made us run the hill 4 times
Then you'll sleep well tonight.
i cracked my phone
How bad?
just the corner. it still works
Then it's a corner.
it was in the case
Then the case did its job.
can i stay up til 11 its summer
10:30, and you're welcome.
happy fathers day
lucía burned the first pancake dont say anything
Thank you, mijo. I didn't see a thing.
can u buy me vbucks
No.
its only 10 dollars
Frank pays 10 dollars to pull weeds. Ask him.
can i buy fireworks w diego
No.
just the fountain ones
Grandpa already bought fountains. Ask him to let you light one.
bet
my teeth hurt so bad
They tightened them. It gets better in a couple of days.
can i have ice cream for dinner
Soup first. Then ice cream.
soup is for old ppl
Soup is for people with braces.
same thing
can we go to peter piper tonight
It's Monday.
lucía wants to
Lucía didn't ask me. You did.
pls
After the walk, if Mom says yes.
she said yes
can i sleep at diegos
Is his dad home?
ya
Then yes. Text me in the morning.
morning
can u take me and diego to desert sky
For what?
idk just to walk around
It's 112. Walk around the house.
home
How was it?
fine
ms nguyen is cool
math is gonna be bad
We'll do math together.
u dont know 8th grade math
I'll learn it.
do i have to go to open house
Yes.
why
So I know which teacher to call.
thats why i dont want to go
are we going
When Mom gets home with the car. Cleats on.
theyre on
mom made me take my hoodie off for the picture
I know. I told her to.
betrayal
Grandma is going to frame it anyway.
can i go to little caesars w diego
i need like 8 dollars
There's a ten in the kitchen drawer. Bring back the change.
bet
can i go to teh maryvale high game w diego
Who's driving?
his dad
Home by 9:30.
home
Good. Goodnight, mijo.
Up. We leave at 8:15.
im up
Your light is off.
its on now
Mom's birthday is Sunday. Lucía wants to get her earrings. You in?
ya. i have 6 dollars
Then you're in for six.
can it say from me too
It says from all three of us.
grandpa taught me dominoes
Did you win?
he cheats
He does. Watch his left hand.
the shoes hurt
Where?
my toes. like bad
Then don't wear them outside. They go back tomorrow.
k
can u drive me saturday
diegos dad cant
Yes. We leave at 8:15.
bet
can i get a new phone for my bday
We'll see.
thats a no
That's a we'll see.
so no
can i go out w diego on halloween
Trick or treating?
nah just walking around. everyone is
Home by 9. Phone charged.
bet
can i stay out til 9:30
omw
can i go to diegos
Homework?
done
Show Mom. Then yes.
nvm hes at his tias
home
Good. I'm ten minutes out.
Mijo your father just left with his thermos and his cash in his sock like always. Please don't let him buy another lamp, we have four lamps in the garage and I am not dusting them
I'll try. No promises.
He came home with a LAMP. With no shade. Mijo I asked you one thing 😂
The man wanted 20 and Dad talked him down to 8. I never had a chance.
8 dollars for a lamp with no shade, Dios mío. Call me tomorrow after Costco

Mijo for Sunday I'm making the mole, your father already bought the chicken so don't argue with me. 12:30. And invite Dana's mom, Carla is with her mother in law that day and I don't want Linda alone on Mother's Day
Mom, it's Mother's Day. You're supposed to rest.
I rest in heaven mijo 😂 bring the kids hungry
Ok. I'll have Dana call her mom tonight.
Linda is coming Sunday. She's bringing her lemon bars.
At Costco. Do you need anything?
Ice and the big paper plates, the strong ones not the cheap ones that bend. Nothing else I mean it
Ice and the strong plates. Got it.

Thank you mijo for my beautiful Mother's Day. The flowers are on the table and Lucia's card is on the refrigerator where everybody can see it. Linda is a sweetheart, I sent her home with mole and she promised me the lemon bar recipe. Tell Dana happy Mother's Day to her to, she is a good mother to my grandkids. Dios te bendiga
Thank you Mom. The mole was perfect. Love you.
Me ho tell Lucy ah I'm so sorry I can't go to her concert Thursday, my knee can't do the bleachers in that gym. Ask Dana to take a video for me please
I will. Dana is going to record the whole thing.
Lucía did great. Dana just sent you the video.
Ay I'm crying, she sang so loud, that's my girl 😭❤️ tell her abuela is so proud
What can I bring tomorrow? I'm making the frijoles charros and the rice. Your father wants to know if he can bring his own chair, he says your patio chairs hurt his back
Beans and rice are perfect. Tell Dad to bring his chair. Come at 1.
We're home mijo. Thank you for the carne asada, your father is already snoring in his recliner 😂
Are you going to call me today or do I have to call the police 😂
Just got back from the walk. Calling you now.

Mijo the doctor says it's the arthritis, the cartilage is almost gone in the right knee. She is sending me to a knee special list and the soonest they have is July 16. Your father is going to drive me
I'm glad you went. Do you want me to come with you?
Happy Father's Day mijo! You are a good father like your dad, don't tell him I said that 😂 Birria at 12:30, come hungry
Thank you Mom. We'll be there at 12:30 after Costco.
Mijo the AC is making a noise like a truck and its 84 in the house. Your father says its fine. Its NOT fine. Can one of your guys come look at it
That sounds like the capacitor. Tony is coming by tomorrow after work, he has one in his truck. Keep the blinds closed and the fans on tonight.
Gracias mijo. I'm making tamales for Tony
76 in the house already!! Tony is a angel. He wouldn't take your father's money so I gave him two dozen tamales. Tell him thank you again
I will. He liked the tamales more than the money.

Javi called, they leave Tucson at 8 tomorrow to beat the heat. Come for lunch when they get here. And Sunday I'm making menudo, come at 8 before Costco, they want to leave by 9:30. Your father is washing the Chevy like the Pope is coming
We're home mijo. What a beautiful day, all the cousins together, and Rudy's ribs!! Is Biscuit ok? Pobrecito he was shaking under the table
He's hiding in the bathtub. He'll stay there till the fireworks stop.
Javi made it home, he says 113 in Tucson. My house is so quiet now. Thank you for bringing the kids this morning mijo
The knee doctor gave me a cortisone shot, it hurt like the devil but now I can walk to the car without your father holding my arm. She says maybe surgery next year but we will see
That's good news. Rest today, Mom.
Mijo are you ok?? Channel 12 says the power is out in Maryvale. Call me
We're ok. Power is out and a big branch came down on the street. Nobody is hurt.
Gracias a Dios. Your father wants to know if you need flashlights, he has like 20 from the swap meet
Power just came back. Good night Mom.
Mijo Javi says you two are cooking for my birthday. I told him I don't want a fuss. But if you are coming anyway I'm making the rice, don't argue with me
You're not cooking on your birthday. Javi is doing the carne and Dana is getting the cake.
Then I make the rice and that's it 😂
Send me pictures of the kids first day!! 8th grade and 4th grade, Dios mío where did the time go
Dana took them. She'll send them.
Did you catch anything with Gilbert? Tell him I said hi, I remember when he used to eat all my tortillas after school
Two small stripers. Gilbert got a big catfish and he won't stop talking about it.
Gracias a Dios for 66 years. Your father brought me coffee in bed, he never does that, I think Javi told him to 😂
Happy birthday Mom. We'll be there at 12:30.

Thank you mijo for the most beautiful birthday. The picture of the three grandkids is already on the wall by the Virgen. The carne was perfect, tell Javi he did ok too 😂 and the cake was too pretty to cut. Lucia singing Las Mañanitas so loud I can still hear it. I have the best family. Dios te bendiga
Happy birthday again, Mom. Lucía is still singing Las Mañanitas in her room.
Your father says there's a Maytag at the swap meet for you. Please mijo don't let him bring a washer to this house, we don't have room for a washer and four lamps
We don't need a washer, Mom. Ours works fine.

Mijo the padre asked me to run the kitchen for the kermés again, October 17 and 18. I said yes because who else is going to do it, those young ladies don't know how to make tamales for 400 people. Your father says I'm crazy with my knee
Your father says your washer is grinding and he told you so. I don't know what that means but I'm lighting a candle for it
It still runs. Dad is enjoying this a lot.
The shot is wearing off. Now the doctor wants physical therapy Monday and Wednesday mornings. Your father drives me and complains the whole way and then he flirts with the receptionist 😂
Go to every one, Mom. Even if he complains.
Tell Dana happy birthday from us mijo! I sent her a text but she's probably busy. 39, a baby
I'll tell her. Carla's family is coming at 1 and I'm grilling.
Ready for my babies tomorrow! I have the cereal Mateo likes and strawberries for Lucia. Dana drops them at 7:30?
7:30. She'll pick them up after work, around 4:45.
Perfect. Your father says he's taking Mateo to the swap meet Wednesday, Dios nos ampare
The kids are here safe. Mateo went right back to sleep on the couch and Lucia is already helping me fold the flyers for the kermés
